text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Hello there, I'm Etsuko Otonashi! As a reporter for 
"Twinkle Monthly", and a deeply passionate Uma Musume 
racing fan, I'm thrilled to be covering them every day.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Today, I've come to Tracen to gather
material for our upcoming special issue.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Someone's sleeping.
Huh! That mane-like hair... could it be?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Stop right there. How disrespectful...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You dare disturb my slumber? Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Tyrant,' Orfevre-san—an Uma Musume with 
an aura befitting a king. She steals the spotlight, 
as a dazzling star of the racing world should.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? I see. So, you say you wish to interview me, woman?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Um, y-yes! Of course! Finding you is like 
hitting the jackpot! Or rather, like having an Uma 
Musume descend upon me from the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I shall permit this interview.
So long as you swear fealty to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am the king of this era. With your pen, 
you shall capture the glory of living under my rule.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(What an intimidating presence!)
Please allow me the honor of writing it.
Haa...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It’s always... only her. Sure, she’s got the skill and attitude 
so she’d obviously be the center of attention. But why...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Huh? The reporter is coming over here? Could she maybe...
possibly be looking to interview someone else? 
In that case, maybe there's a chance it’ll be me!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmm, a special issue? And you want to interview me for it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(The “Lady” Gentildonna—she too is a force to be reckoned 
with, exuding the aura of a formidable Uma Musume!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I just finished interviewing Orfevre-san, and if you happen
to be free, I would love to hear your thoughts as well!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that’s fine. If there's going to be an 
article about Orfevre-san, then naturally, there should 
be an article about the one who's stronger than her.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Those who possess overwhelming power will inevitably 
achieve victory and become a symbol of justice.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
―― In other words, "strength". That is what makes a winner.
Therefore, by training like this day after day...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Umm... Gentil-san?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, I've fallen into my bad habit again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Don’t we have a harder shot put ball somewhere? This hardly counts as muscle training. *sigh* Whatever, let's finish the interview first. I'll go get changed.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Hnn, hnnnnnn...! Dang it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess I’m still not strong enough...
Wait! The reporter’s already gone! 
Next time, I’ll reach out to her...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Gentil, why do you appear before me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don’t be scared. The reporter simply wants
 to take a photo of the two of us for their feature piece.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You don’t mind, do you? I know standing next to me 
might make you look even worse than you already do.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
How ridiculous. Woman! If she's going 
to stay then I will be taking my leave.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: If that’s the case, then would you consider featuring us instead?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A feature piece on us? That sounds like 
so much fun♪ Can you interview us, pretty please♡

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(The sisters Verxina and Vivlos! Along with Cheval Grand, 
they form a trio of three of the most formidable Uma Musume!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, I couldn’t care less. After all, no matter who you are, 
you’ll always be behind me—Nothing will ever change the 
fact that you are all "second place" to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Second place. Yes, that may be true as of now. 
I agree that you are noble and indeed quite strong.
Until now, I’ve only ever come in behind you...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
But I promise you, here and now, the one that will 
defeat you will be none other than myself. For I am 
the Uma Musume destined to stand at the very top!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
By the time this article is published, 
you might have already lost your crown. 
I wonder if you’ll still be this composed when that happens.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Woah♡ Big Sis, I always knew you were cool, 
but this is something else! Hey, Miss Reporter, 
c’mon! Please put us in the special issue!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Including Cheval, would you be so kind as 
to include us in your piece? Plus, if you make the 
cover sparkle it’ll look super glam and sell like crazy ♡

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Glam? Yeah right, what a joke! No one would eat that slop!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mayday mayday, Body, Soul, do you copy? 
This is Gold Ship with a wonderful new look! Now, eat this instead ☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship!? Where on earth did you come from!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
From the New World! This is Gold Ship version 564, over. 
I don’t care if you're a tyrant, a lady, or two emotional sisters—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I always have been, and always will be the trendsetter! 
Peace peace! Let’s give it our all! Ready, set, boom! Phew...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha, Everyone sure does stand out, huh...? 
And here I am, I can’t do— No, instead of moping, I should be—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Umm, excuse me! Miss Reporter, would you please feature me as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Win Variation-san?! I-I’d love to, but what’s gotten into you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I may not stand out like everyone else right now, 
but one day, I’ll shine brighter than anyone.
I’ll be the one and only star!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Keep watching and supporting me. Admire my ambition... 
and witness my future! So please, I want to be in the photo too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You want me to do a pose? Wow... 
I-I guess I’ll do one too! W-Wait, am I doing something wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind. The theme of this special issue will be... 
"Brilliant Personalities! The Beginning of a New Era!"— 
Alright girls, let's continue with the interviews!
